svg.text: The open-source stack: network, kernel, host and firewall signals under one roof
SIEM core (e.g. Wazuh manager, rules + correlation)
correlates all four sources against a ruleset, writes structured, timestamped alerts
single-node docker-compose, roughly 4 GB RAM — no Kubernetes required
Indexer + dashboard (OpenSearch) — full-text search, retention, compliance views
